item.title: Airship VR Game
item.author: jonas.mht.private@gmail.com (Jonas Mehtali)
item.description:
Description

I created a VR airship puzzle-survival game using Unity during my last semester at the University of Strasbourg. I wrote the game logic in Unity and created the 3D assets and textures using Blender.
The player’s goal is to repair a sinking airship by solving interactive puzzles by clocking buttons, switching switches and turning handles. The game is designed for the Meta VR headset and uses the handheld controller tracking feature to interact with the environment.
This project provided me with valuable hands-on experience in Unity game development for VR headsets and project management, which I believe, as for all projects undertaken, will come in handy in my future ventures.

item.title: Project Notre Dame
item.author: jonas.mht.private@gmail.com (Jonas Mehtali)
item.description:
Description

During a six-month long project, I led a 3D team of three students to create all the 3D assets and visuals for an artistic and cultural mediation app for the Musée Notre Dame de Strasbourg.

Mission

The goal of this project was to create 3D models of a painting displayed in the Musée Notre Dame de Strasbourg.
The 3D models were then used to create a mobile application that would allow visitors to discover the painting and its history in a new way.

Videos

Sample of 3D models

Tutorial (French)

I recorded a tutorial in French to explain how I created the 3D models of the painting.
Its purpose was to help the other members of the team to create their own 3D models.

Compilation of all the 3D models

Images

Conclusion

All along this project I develop my leadership and technical skills, as well as the ability to work in a collaborative environment.
It was a challenging and rewarding experience that allowed me to acquire valuable skills and knowledge for my future projects.

item.title: Nacht Der Teddybären
item.author: jonas.mht.private@gmail.com (Jonas Mehtali)
item.description:
Description

As part of a two-student team, I created a Teddy-Zombie survival game using Unity within a four-month timeframe. My responsibilities for the project included working on the AI, 3D asset modeling and texturing using Blender, fire control, enemy spawner, and wave system. This project provided me with valuable hands-on experience in Unity game development and project management, which I believe will come in handy in my future ventures.
